---
title: "Test Helpers"
author: "Tom Naber"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
knit: (function(inputFile, encoding) { launcher <- "Launcher App.R"; if(!file.exists(launcher)) stop("Launcher App.R not found in working dir"); env <- new.env(); sys.source(launcher, envir = env); params <- NULL; if (exists("launch_params", envir = env, mode = "function")) { params <- env$launch_params() } else if (exists("get_params", envir = env, mode = "function")) { params <- env$get_params() } else if (exists("params", envir = env)) { params <- env$params } else { if (!requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Launcher App.R requires shiny but shiny is not installed"); if (exists("app", envir = env)) { params <- shiny::runApp(env$app, launch.browser = FALSE) } else if (exists("ui", envir = env) && exists("server", envir = env)) { params <- shiny::runApp(list(ui = env$ui, server = env$server), launch.browser = FALSE) } else stop("Launcher App.R must provide launch_params(), params, or an app/ui+server variable that returns params via shiny::stopApp()") }; if (!is.list(params) || is.null(names(params))) stop("Launcher did not return a named list of params"); id <- paste0(names(params), "-", unlist(lapply(params, as.character)), collapse = "_"); id <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+','_', id); outdir <- here::here("Output"); if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE); outname <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(inputFile)), "_", id, ".html"); outfile <- file.path(outdir, outname); rmarkdown::render(inputFile, encoding = encoding, params = params, output_file = outfile) })
output:
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    df_print: paged
    highlight: tango
    self_contained: true
    fig_width: 6.4
    fig_height: 4.8
    code_folding: hide
editor_options:
  markdown:
    wrap: 80
  chunk_output_type: console
params:
  research_data_folder: 
    label: "Research data folder"
    value: "local"
    input: select
    choices: ["local", "remote"]
---

# Set-up

## Set options & import sources

```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 6.4,
                      fig.height = 4.8,
                      dpi = 300,
                      fig.retina = 1,
                      out.width = "100%",
                      out.height = "100%",
                      dev = "ragg_png")

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(sameplot)

source(here("Scripts", "universal_helpers.R"))
```

# Make plot

```{r}
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(mtcars, ggplot2::aes(wt, mpg)) + ggplot2::geom_point()
```

# Sameplot render (save and include)

```{r}
sameplot(p, file = file.path("Output", "plot.png"), save = TRUE)
```

# Knitr/RStudio backend render

```{r}
p
print(params$lower_peak_window)
```

# Render raw file absolutely

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
  '<img src="%s">',
  knitr::image_uri(here::here("Output", "plot.png"))
))
```
